{{Quote|Can you help me? The lower maintenance areas are full of droids, but there are also security droids in the area. The droids must be destroyed, but we can't risk harming the security ones.|Lieutenant Cyru Sarkee, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DNSD" />}}
'''Cyru Sarkee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the technology-hating Meatlumps and operated out of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]].<ref name="SWG:DNSD" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he tasked a spacer to destroy [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels#Lower Maintenance Areas|lower maintenance areas]] of Coronet's [[Coronet Maintenance Tunnels|maintenance tunnels]]. The spacer therefore descended into the hostile lower maintenance areas and attacked the droids, mostly utilitarian droids, working in the area. As ordered by Sarkee, the spacer avoided to attack the [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]], [[S-1 security droid|S-1]] and [[S-2 security droid]]s, patrolling the tunnels to not alarm the [[Corellian Security Force]]. The spacer finally destroyed thirty-four [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droids]], [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]], [[R5-series astromech droid]]s and [[blastromech droid]]s.<ref name="SWG:DNSD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cyru Sarkee appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DNSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cyru Sarkee was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]," introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
